newsitem.title: USA: Alliance says settles trading case with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Alliance says settles trading case with SEC.

text.p: Alliance Capital Management LP said Monday it settled a Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding related to personal securities trading by a former portfolio manager at Alliance, Roger Honour.

The SEC had charged Alliance with failing to adequately supervise Honour's personal trading activities while he was employed at Alliance. Without admitting or denying the SEC's allegations, Alliance said it agreed to a censure and to pay a $100,000 civil penalty.
Alliance said the SEC did not charge Alliance with any intentional or willful conduct or complicity.
Honour was employed by the investment advisor between March 1990 and February 1992, the company said.
In September 1995, the SEC entered into a settlement with Honour relating to his personal trading while he was employed at Alliance and subsequently at another investment adviser, the company said.
